title: LRU eviction for the cache
requirement:
cache.Cache(capacity) stores values with put(key, value) and get(key, default=None) but never evicts.
Make it a least-recently-used cache: when a put would exceed capacity, evict the least recently used
key. Both get (on a hit) and put count as a use. len(cache) returns the number of stored keys.
capacity < 1 raises ValueError.
